rejected.reason: Moving to a tracking system or registry category violates the requirement to stay within the HackerGroup category.

ladder.notes: The presence of multiple naming conventions (UAC codes vs. common names) suggests that UAC-0028 and APT28 refer to the same entity. The ladder reflects the removal of tracking prefixes/identifiers to reach the primary name used in intelligence reports.
